slides.title: Is this [[you]]?
items: Scrolling in bed long after dark
Eyes feel tired by late evening
You forget to blink at the screen

slides.title: Eyes stuck [[up close]]
slides.body: Phones and laptops keep your eyes focused at the same short distance for hours. Without breaks to look far away, eyes can feel tired.
slides.speech: Look up once in a while~

slides.title: You [[blink]] less
slides.body: When you stare at a screen, you tend to blink less often. Add dry, heated indoor air in winter, and your eyes can feel dry by night.

items.head: Try the 20-20-20 habit
items.sub: Each 20 min: 20 ft away for 20 sec

items.head: Blink slowly on purpose
items.sub: A few slow blinks between tasks

items.head: Dim screens after dark
items.sub: Lower brightness, add a warm lamp

slides.title: Screen [[checklist]]
slides.note: Lifestyle tips only. If it lasts, talk to a professional.

slides.title: Rest your eyes with [[Calm]]~
slides.body: Save, share and tell a friend

caption:
Long night, lots of screen time? 📱

Hours of close-up focus and fewer blinks can leave your eyes feeling tired, and dry heated air in winter adds to it.
Try three small habits starting tonight:
Try the 20-20-20 habit · Blink slowly on purpose · Dim screens after dark
